blocks.text: In Santa Cruz, you'll get to know the city before heading to Samaipata and Amboró Park. Highlights of the first leg include El Fuerte fortress, the cloud forest and the Cuevas waterfalls. The route gradually climbs into the more rugged highlands of the Andes. In Sucre, you'll see the city's colonial heritage and historic buildings. The journey then continues through Potosí to Uyuni and on to the salt flats, Incahuasi Island, the Siloli Desert and the high-altitude lagoons. The final leg takes you through Lake Titicaca, Copacabana, Sun Island and La Paz.
